search_text: $\int_1^i\frac{\ln(z+1)}{z+1}\,dz=(\quad)$，沿 $|z|=1$ 的第一象限部分。 $-\frac18\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4}+3\ln^2 2\right)+i\frac{\pi}{8}\ln 2$ $-\frac18\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4}+3\ln^2 2\right)-i\frac{\pi}{8}\ln 2$ $-\frac14\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4}+3\ln^2 2\right)-i\frac{\pi}{4}\ln 2$ $\frac14\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4}+3\ln^2 2\right)-i\frac{\pi}{4}\ln 2$ $\int_1^i\frac{\ln(z+1)}{z+1}\,dz=\frac12\ln^2(z+1)\big|_1^i=\frac12[\ln^2(i+1)-\ln^2 2]$。因 $\ln(i+1)=\ln\sqrt2+\frac{\pi}{4}i=\frac12\ln2+\frac{\pi}{4}i$，所以结果为 $-\frac18(\frac{\pi^2}{4}+3\ln^2 2)+i\frac{\pi}{8}\ln2$。
